name: Bassano, Costalunga
description:
Takeoff can be turbulent when the wind goes from S towards SW in the afternoon.

The main landing is behind Piazza Paradiso, a 200m stroll down from Tilly's Locanda in Semonzo.

This landing field is located behind the office of the Club Volo Libero Montegrappa, west of the residential area of piazza Paradiso di Semonzo. This field is used exclusively for paragliding pilots, due to its location close to the base of the mountain, offering a very valid landing point. To find it, along the main road from Romando d'Ezzelino to Borso del Grappa, turn left in via Chiesa (road used to access the top of Monte Grappa on the road Strada Generale Giardino), after about 300m on your left you'll see a piazza and the residential complex, turn left and drive around the back of the complex.

Pay attention to the turbulence caused by the east wind during landing, and to the houses on the east side of the field. Other than these points, it offers a relatively safe landing area with a good car park and possibility of returning swiftly to the take-off areas

name: Bernadia - Nimis
description:
Bernardia is an option for Gemona area. The main takeoff of the whole area is Monte Cuarnan, with shuttles running from Bordano landing. We have used this takeoff because there was snow!!! (I know snow at 1000m in Italy, almost May!!!) and it worked good even for a small task for Freedom Open 2024.
It could be an option if accommodation is closer to the area or if there is a predominant easterly wind. 
It’s easy access by road, the last 200m of road is gravel but accessible by any car. The last few tens of meters are to be walked, flat terrain path and then a bit downhill. 
Nice takeoff, good for 2-3 glider simultaneous, good slope, good for any level. Official landing is with windsock, on nice, flat, large terrain. Other options available too. Apparently the whole area is renowned for a good, sweet, strong white wine. Cannot be wrong to land on any suitable field.

name: Big Sur Flight Park (Garda Lake)
description:
Suitable for all levels, hang gliders and paragliders.


BigSur SkyPark is part of the Parco Alto Garda (north Garda park), which covers over 38,000 hectares and includes the largest publicly-owned forest in Lombardy. As a result, the area is one of the most valuable nature resources in Italy. The landscape is remarkable in its variety, changing from the shoreline areas of Lake Garda with its cypresses, olive and citrus groves, to the mountain peaks a little further back, with fauna that includes Alpine ibex and chamois deer. In the air, you may even find yourself flying in company of a golden eagle. 

Launch and landing sites

The launch sites are on the southern slopes of Mount Pizzocolo, at a location named Pirello.

Pirello south launch site:
1,160 m
Google-Earth coordinates 45°39? 56? N  10° 33? 40? E
suitable for all levels, hang gliders and paragliders

Pirello west launch site:
height 1,210 m
Google Earth coordinates 45°40’03”N 10°40’49”E
suitable for all levels, hang gliders and paragliders

Colomber landing field:
height 400 m
Google Earth coordinates 45°38? 30? N  10° 33’ 02? E
efficiency required: 3.5
circuit: left-hand C.
easy for paragliders; for hang glider pilots with some experience (minimum 30 flights)

Montesei landing field:
height 370 m
Google Earth coordinates 45°37’58”N 10°35’55”E
efficiency required: 4.8
circuit: left-hand C
suitable for pilots of all levels, the landing field is very large

Toscolano beach landing:
height 63 m
Google Earth coordinates 45° 38? 23? N  10° 37“ 13? E
efficiency required: 5
circuit: left-hand C with south wind, right-hand C with north wind
requires a good level of experience (minimum 100 flights)

WINDS

Launch is possible with wind from south, east and west.
Launch is not possible with strong winds from the north.

N.B. the fact that the launch site faces south-east means that thermal soaring is possible from relatively early in the morning.

Flying difficulty:
This flying site is ideal for all levels, both hang gliders and paragliders.
Cross-country flights are possible:

Southwards: easy
Westwards: moderately difficult
Northwards and eastwards: difficult

N.B. from BigSur SkyPark, flights of over 150 km have been made in all directions.
Here, the most representative tops of the mountains of the area, photographed from the summit of Mount Pizzocolo.

Our efficient shuttle service with two nine-seat Land Rover Defenders means that all you have to think about is your flight!

name: Campitello Di Fassa, Col Rodella
description:
Take the cablecar to the start.
Very demanding conditions! Best season is september.
Landing: N 46° 28' 34'' E 11° 45' 03''
The aerial arena above Col Rodella and the Sella Pass has a worldwide reputation for the best flying you can find in the Dolomites in late summer
and autumn. It’s fascinating and breathtaking, but reckless launches in leeside conditions and overcrowding by hundreds of pilots in late September
are ongoing problems, so Belvedere is a good alternative and the Sella saddle as well. Choose when and where to go
carefully. If in doubt, stand down, and take an experienced guide for your own safety and enjoyment!

Borowed from ParaglidingEarth:
There are two main take-offs, the first is located just 100 meters from the Col Rodella cable car station near the refuge Des Alpes. Going down the ridge from the hut we note the windsock; on the left side (towards the Gardena valley) is used when the wind comes from the North (the area under the two chair lifts with exposure to the North is customarily used for hang-gliders take off) . The right side (Fassa valley side) is used when the wind comes from South and Southeast and in the early hours of thermal activity, normally until 12.00am. After this time there is a gradual strengthening of the breeze of the Fassa valley, so use a take-off from the South to West facing. This take-off is reached by turning right out of the station and the cable car going down the path that passes under the cable car line in the direction of the road equipped with Rodella, at this point we can see the windsock. If you come from Sella Pass, park the car before the bar near the refuge Valentini and walk for about 30 minutes. In winter take-offs remain viable only North and South-Southeast.

Landing:
The main landing is located about 200 meters east of the Col Rodella cable car station, there is a wind sock on the west side. The landing is very big and easy, but we must be alert to the power line that crosses this longitudinally to the normal landing path. The secondary landing just across the river at the beginning of the town of Canazei. The windsock is located more or less at the center of the landing and this is equally easy. For both landings normally there is a landing direction from west to east during the morning, increasing in the afternoon breeze starts to land from east to west, in that case pay attention to the trees situated at beginning of the landings, which could create rotors in case of strong breeze.

Weather Info: 
http://www.arpa.veneto.it/... 
http://www.meteotrentino.it/ 
Pay particular attention to moderate winds from the North and East in general, in these conditions, the area becomes very dangerous and turbulent. In any case, the flight in spring and summer in the central hours (11:00am to 5:00pm) is only recommended for experienced pilots. However, towards evening it is possible for less 
experienced pilots to make a beautiful soaring flights (South, Southeast Takeoff).

Hovedlandingen er på et jordet ca 800m fra starten og er markert med 2stk vindpølser. Det er en høyspentledning rett foran landingsjordet og midt i innflygingen, så vær obs på den. Ellers god plass!

Parkering:

Starten:
Start frå toppen er best mot N/NV eller S/SØ.

Start mot Ø/NØ er truleg best på den lågare toppen mot Ø der det og går ein skiheis opp(NB eg har sjølv ikkje sjekka om det er mogeleg å ta av der).
NB! Når det er folk på ski i anlegget er det ikkje plass å legga ut vinga mot N/NV, og ein må opp på ryggen på toppen der det er ein liten stupstart.

description:
Just west of Feltre.
The grassy dome and viewpoint of Monte Avena, above the Piave valley, is an excellent start for adventures along the southern Dolomites. It is also
a good alternative site to the Monte Grappa / Bassano area but with less infrastructure. The landings and launches are wide and easy, but you
have to take your own vehicle. A good place for a spring cross country flight and for your first toplanding!

name: Gallodoro - Letojanni - Sicily
description:
Great big and easy start on 500m. Do not get low to the terrain lower than start - electrical wires is hard to see, and you get three spans located a bit lower than start. Landing situated by the end of the river that comes out on Letojanni beach on the Island of Sicily. You don't see it from the start - but the location is totally obvious once airbourne. 
Contact Marco (Italian National paraglider champion) at EtnaFly to get the local details. Great site for soaring and thermals. Shuttlebus to the starts for 4 euros.

name: Meduno
description:
Perfect site for EASY Flying til sunset
Meduno has only recently become a ‘secret spot’ for those who like to escape the bad weather
in the north (or from overcrowded Bassano). Monte Valinis offers huge meadows that are easy
for paragliders and hang-gliders to launch and ground-handle. The strong summer breeze
and the hilly environment are reminiscent of the Umbrian Hills in Middle Italy. The area is more
complicated than Bassano for cross country because of the narrow river valleys and the huge
forested areas. One needs to get really high! On the other hand it is a fun place with famous
summer restitution (valley release) – you can sometimes fly from 16h00 until it’s almost dark,
then topland or head out across the flatlands!

name: Meran 2000/Piffinger Köpfl
description:
Suedtirol
Several sites exist around the city of Meran. The grassy spur of Hochmuth provides better flying during the morning and midday, but the west-facing slopes at Hirzer yield better afternoon thermals. Both sites offer panoramic views and XC flights. 
The best meeting place is Törgglerhof landing at Saltaus, where pilots and their families find comfortable accommodation and a warm welcome.

name: Molveno - øvre start
description:
Ta gondolheisen fra Molveno opp til mellomstasjonen, og deretter skiheisen videre til toppen. Takeoff ligger ca 200m fra heisens toppunkt retning sørøst. Fin sørvendt gress-start som har plass til 5-6 vinger.

Rett vest for takeoff ligger fjellet Cima Tosa med en tårnende høyde på 3173 m.

Landingen ligger rett ved stranden i nord-enden av vannet og er av typen som krever god kontroll på innflygning, da den er skrånende nedover og ender i vannet. Som regel er der en bris inn fra vannet hver ettermiddag som hjelper til med å få landet perfekt.

Tandem-folkene der har en bemannet info-stand rett ved landingen i sommersesongen. Spør der om det er noe du lurer på.

Bilde: Stranden i Molveno med landingen nede til høyre.

Se også her for mer info:
http://www.molveno.it/lang/EN/homepage

description:
Taubane opp til en fantastisk startplass. Vær obs på sterk vind i Gardasjøen (kjent surfested). Få landinger. Sjekk med kjentfolk. Topplanding anbefales

Launch:
1. (W/SW) 1760m, easy, 15 min walk north of the cablecar station on the wide ridge. Toplandable.
GPS: 45°46’34.79”N, 10°51’47.47”E
2. (NE) 1760m, easy, about 10 min N of launch 1, on the ridge. Rarely in use.
3. (E/SE) 1760m, easy, just opposite the W launch.

Landing:
Malcesine (60m) huge green, artificial runway, the ‘aircraft carrier’ on the eastern lakeshore about 1.5 km N of the edge of Malcesine. There is no other landing spot – check the landing before you go flying!
 Also, the parking spaces are limited (especially
in summer). So rather leave your car parked
at the cablecar station or bring a bike and leave it locked at the landing area. The landing will offer a restaurant and regular services during season, from 2011 onward. 
GPS: 45°46’54.86”N, 10°49’3.39”E.

name: Monte Caira
description: Fint berg med flott utsikt. Ligger i nærheten av Monte Cassino (a monastery on top of the hill., ca. 6.5 km). Les info tavler på landing !

name: Monte Casale, Trentino
description: Kommer senere

name: Monte Cornizzolo (Suello - Como)
description:
Takeoff used for PWC. Landing in Suello.
No private driving to takeoff. There are normally mini-busses leaving from landing in Suello.

Launch:
Risparmio Basso (SE-SW) 1045m, easy, the main takeoff on the central S slope below the road and 100m below the summit.
GPS: 45°49’58.40”N, 9°18’7.67”E. 
The only direct access is by shuttle bus.

2. Centrale (SE-W) 1130m, easy. The big grassy western shoulder
has a wide choice of launches, usually occupied by competitions.
GPS: 45°50’0.93”N, 9°17’34.70”E. From the service road walk up (20 min)
3. Risparmio Alto (SE-SW) 1210m, easy. Not often used, but some
people like it. 25 min hike to the summit from the lower takeoff.
GPS: 45°50’13.65”N, 9°18’7.82”E

name: Monte Crocione, Lake Como
description:
Mulig å starte i alle retninger, med unntak av nordlig. 
Flere startmuligheter i området. 

Landing på den gamle flystripen fra WW2 i Ballegio. Her må man krysse Comosjøen så ta hensyn til vindstyrke og vingevalg. Info om landingen finnes på appen "Paragliding Map"

name: Monte Cucco, Sigillo
description: Himla bra ställe !

name: Monte Maddalena
description: Monte Maddalena

name: Monte Vigo, Val Meledrio, Trentino
description: Takeoff i fleire retningar frå toppen av skiheisen.

name: Monte croce di Muggio, Alpe Giumello, Chiesetta
description: East side of lake Como.

name: Monte delle Mine, Livigno
description: Skildring kjem.

name: Mottolino, Livigno
description: Takeoff in Livigno, near the Mottolino gondola.

name: Muthöfe/Hochmuth - Merano
description: Skildring kjem.

name: Naturnser Hochjoch/Giogo Alto, Vinschgau/Val Venosta, Südtirol
description: Fleire mogelege stadar å ta av frå.

name: Nord for Bassano
description:
Ligger ved et skisportsenter og er ypperlig til hangflyging. 
Mulighet til å fly på flere vindrettninger.

name: Norma
description:
Flott termisk hang; Gå opp vei (ca. 10 min) gjennom område med arkiologisk utgravninger - fint å fly over fjell-byen Norma.

Selv om det melder østlig(bakvind) kan det være meget fint å fly her. Østavinden går høyt over byen, brisen fra sjøen bestemmer som regel her. Termikken kan være skarp midt på dagen(ca.12-14.30), for de ferskeste kan det være lurt å ta en lunsj el lingnende midt på dagen. 

Landinga ligger rett foran start med to tre på sørsiden og et på norsiden, vindpøle også. Man bør fly ut på 250 moh for og nå sikkert ned. Finnes ei reservelanding til venstre men den bør man helst ikke bruke(utalelser fra den lokale pg-skolen)

Ifølge den lokale pg-skolen hadde dem 320 flydager i 2008.

name: Peitlerkofel, Dolomittene
description: Takeoff under toppen på gras-skråning.

name: Pieve d'Alpago - Dolada
description:
From airtribune.com:

Mt Dolada
Take-off: 1494 m ASL (N 46.1917°, E 12.3527°)
Landing: 598 m ASL (N 46.1582°, E 12.3684°)
The main take-off will be Monte Dolada right above Pieve. From the centre of Pieve there are signs directing you up the road to launch ground. A tarmac road ends with a car park. From there it’s an easy 100-m walk to the take-off located just behind the mountain hostel "Rifugio Dolada". The landing is located in Garna. It’s a big grassy field next to a small building of the local paragling club Dolada.

name: Poggio Bustone, north.
description: Main start in Poggio Bustone. Steap grass hill used for hangliding. Large parking. Access by narrow gravel road. Nice picnic table at carpark.

name: Poggio Bustone, south.
description: Accessible by car on unpaved gravel road. Last 200m by fot, no incline. Lots of space for many pilot on takeoff. Beginnerfriendly grass slope.

name: Pradalago, Madonna di Campiglio, Trentino
description: Takeoff frå toppen av skianlegget over Madonna di Campiglio.

name: Revine
description: Start på fjellet over Revine, Treviso.

name: Rifugio Auronzo, Dolomittane
description: Fleire moglege takoffar i området.

name: Rifugio Monzino, Courmayeur
description: Takeoff ved hytta, stupstart nokon stadar.

name: Roncola
description:
Spacious south oriented meadow on the mountain near Roncolo. About 20 minutes walk from where the shuttle drops you off (€ 5,00 for the shuttle to the start).
Hang gliders start from the "antenna" start at 920 meters
See http://vololiberobergamo.it/pagine/menu/mappa.html for a map of the landing zone (a big field next to the golf club) and other useful information

name: San Simeone
description:
Perfect takeoff area just above the landing at Bordano. It's much closer to drive from Bordano landing to this takeoff, compared to the main takeoff at Gemona. The road is narrow and very twisty but the surface is very good so it's accessible with any car.

In a good day the takeoff it's exposed to the valley wind so it might be difficult to push upwind and connect with the mountain in front if there is a plan for XC.

name: Seceda - Val Gardena/Gherdëina - Südtirol
description:
Flott startplass  ved sida av Geislerdolomittane.
Heis(2 heisar) opp til start går nesten heile året.

Parkering:
Parkering ved skianlegget sin parkering ved Seceda-heisen i Ortisei/Urtijëi.

Starten:
Tre offisielle startar(sjå biletet):
1. Sørstarten(2500 moh.): Mot toppen av Seceda.
2. Sør- og øststarten(2450 moh.): Rett i nærheten av toppstasjonen til heisen.
3. Veststarten(2360 moh.): Gå litt nedover langs ryggen frå heisen. Delvis stupstart.

I lufta:
- OBS! Hald god avstand til wiren til heisen og høgspentledninga ved sida av.
- Aldri fly ved nordföhn!
- Det kan vera sterk turbulens ved vind frå N.
- Det er sterk termikk frå april til september, og det krever då mykje flyerfaring for å fly mellom kl. 13 og 17.

Landing:
Landing ved Baita Pauli-hytta i nærheten av starten av heisen i Ortisei/Urtijëi.
Innflygning som vist på biletet. Ver obs på at det er skiløype med folk i på store delar av landinga om vinteren.

Sjå biletet for meir info.
Du kan ta kontakt med Heinz i Parapendio Club Ghërdeina på +39 339 6709659 for meir info.

name: Seebergl, Mühlwalder Tal, Südtirol
description: Graskledd topp.

name: Serrone
description: The first take-off is located at an altitude of 880 meters, with exposure from south south-east to south south-west. On this take-off you can find a wooden gazebo with table and benches, it is the most used as it can be reached in just 5 minutes from the historic center.

name: Sextner Stein, Dolomites
description: Steinete topp ved Toblinger Knoten og Dreizinnenhütte.

name: Speikboden, Sand in Taufers
description:
Alpine Takeoff for BIG distances - especially in Summer.
Difficult for XC in northerly conditions. Soaring possible!
A jewel hidden in South Tyrol, where long deep valleys run up to the main ranges of the Alps.
 Speikboden has a growing reputation as one of the cross country highlights of the eastern Alps. With valleys and ridges and glaciated peaks all around, Speikboden forms the centrepiece for trips into nearly any direction. 

Just below it, the takeoff at Ahornach (situated straight above Sand) is more accessible, offering everything from spring-time thermals to good training flights for pilots with less experience.

SPEIKBODEN
1. Speikboden (N/S) 2362m–2400m, easy-medium,
GPS: 46°54’54.63”N, 11°53’55.33”E. From the cablecar
walk down the saddle (big windsock) where the ski
piste descends. You will find several takeoff possibilities
there, extending about 50m up the ridge.
2. Speikboden summit (N/S/E) 2510m, easymedium,
around the summit of Speikboden, follow
the ridge from the cablecar for about 25 min.

Landing:
Sand in Taufers (870m) industrial zone.
GPS: 46°54’41.34”N, 11°57’38.54”E.
Taxi Albin Tel. +39 347 353 3353(www.taxisandintaufers.com). It’s the shuttle which also takes pilots to Ahornach.

name: Spitzbühl Seiser Alm (Bolzano inte Bassano)
description:
Mäktigt ställe, man ser hela alphuvudkammen i horisonten och marmolada bakom starten och ett värstingberg vid sidan om starten som man inte vagar flyga pa förrän till kvällen. Var ganska turbulent termik när jag var där. Tandemskärmar reagerade som tävlingskärmar med inslag och dyk mm.
Vid nordlig vind sa ska man se upp för dalvinden och helst topplanda vilket är enkelt uppe pa platatn bakom starten

name: Sydtirol - Pfalzen- Platte
description: alternativ lavere start for XC arena Pustertal i Sydtirol. Naermeste by er Bruneck.

name: Tete des Fra, Aosta
description: H&F-takeoff

name: Tuscola
description:
Soaring spot in archeological park. Road and parking pretty close with a five minute walk to a small area which works as a takeoff (but possible to take off other places on the ridge too). Big landing field and possible to land further up. Need sufficient wind.
(Listed on paragliding map)

name: Veneto-Bassano, Col del Pupolo
description: Ramp start, with nice landing in the walley! Restaurant, water, toilet, just beside the ramp!

name: Vulcano (Aeolian Islands) Sicily NorthEast-East
description: 45-60 minutes walk from the harbour. Landing north of the harbour at the beach.

name: Ösacker, Sarnthein/Sarentino, Südtirol
description: Låg takeoff rett over Sarnthein/Sarentino som fungerer når dalvinden kjem inn dalen.
